tests.title: Add-on Registration
steps: Run the registration script (sys.path insert + import blender; blender.register())
Check the system console for errors
expected: Console prints 'BatchExporter registered!' with no errors
No Python tracebacks in the system console
All operators and property groups are registered

tests.title: Menu Entry Visible
steps: After registration, go to File → Export
Look for 'Batch Export…' entry at the bottom of the menu
expected: 'Batch Export…' appears in the Export menu with an EXPORT icon
Clicking it opens the popup dialog (not an immediate error)

tests.title: Add-on Reload (Hot Reload)
steps: Make a code change to any blender/ or core/ module
Run the reload script (unregister → flush sys.modules → re-register)
expected: Unregister completes without errors
Re-register completes without errors
Code changes are reflected in the UI

tests.title: Add-on Preferences
steps: Set a default output directory, default format, default separator
expected: Preference fields are displayed (output dir, format, separator)
Values persist after closing the preferences panel

tests.title: Dialog Opens with Defaults
expected: Output section visible: directory picker, format dropdown, scope dropdown
Preview section visible with a sample filename (e.g. 'ObjectName.fbx')
Naming section collapsed (triangle pointing right)
Filters section collapsed (triangle pointing right)
OK and Cancel buttons at the bottom

tests.title: Collapsible Sections Toggle
steps: Click the 'Naming' triangle to expand it
Click the 'Naming' triangle again to collapse
expected: Naming section expands showing: Prefix, Suffix, Separator, Use Object Name, Use Collection Name, Counter Digits, Create Subdirectories
Naming section collapses hiding all those fields
Filters section expands showing: Filter Prefix, Filter Suffix
Filters section collapses hiding those fields
Triangle icon toggles between TRIA_RIGHT and TRIA_DOWN

tests.title: Live Filename Preview
steps: Expand Naming and set Prefix to 'SM'
expected: Default preview: 'ObjectName.fbx'
After prefix: 'SM_ObjectName.fbx'
After suffix: 'SM_ObjectName_LOD0.fbx'
After collection name: 'SM_Collection_ObjectName_LOD0.fbx'
After glTF format: 'SM_Collection_ObjectName_LOD0.glb'
After subdirs: 'SM/SM_Collection_ObjectName_LOD0.glb'

tests.title: Format Dropdown Lists Available Formats
steps: Review the list of available formats
expected: FBX (.fbx) is listed
glTF (.glb/.gltf) is listed
At least OBJ, USD, Alembic also appear if their operators are enabled
Only formats whose bpy.ops.export_scene.* operator exists are shown

tests.title: Scope Dropdown Options
expected: Four options: 'Selected Objects', 'Collections', 'Scenes', 'All Objects'
Each has a descriptive tooltip on hover

tests.title: Output Directory Picker
tests.notes: output section has two folder symbols, when hovering, one reads accept and the other pick output directory
steps: Click the folder icon next to the output directory field
Navigate to a directory and confirm
expected: Blender file browser opens
After selecting a directory, the path appears in the output field
Path is stored in the scene settings

tests.title: Export Selected Objects
steps: Create a scene with 3 mesh objects (e.g. Cube, Sphere, Cylinder)
Open Batch Export, set scope to 'Selected Objects'
Set output dir to a temp folder, format to FBX
expected: Two .fbx files created: Cube.fbx and Sphere.fbx
Cylinder.fbx is NOT created
Info area shows 'Batch export complete: 2 succeeded, 0 failed'

tests.title: Export by Collections
steps: Open Batch Export, set scope to 'Collections'
Set output dir, format to FBX, click OK
expected: Two .fbx files created: Props.fbx and Env.fbx
Props.fbx contains both meshes from the Props collection
Env.fbx contains the single mesh from Env

Do NOT select anything (selection doesn't matter for 'All')

Set output dir, format to FBX, click OK
expected: Four individual .fbx files created, one per mesh object
Non-mesh objects (cameras, lights) are excluded

tests.title: Prefix and Suffix
tests.notes: LOD support does not work like just a suffix, LODs are often packed into a single fbx, e.g. cube_LOD0, cube_LOD1, cube_LOD2 should all be detected to be the same object and packed into the same fbx, user should have the option to pack LODs if they want, otherwise treat them as separate objects
expected: Output file is named 'SM_Cube_LOD0.fbx'

tests.title: Custom Separator
expected: Output file is named 'SM-Cube.fbx'

tests.title: Collection Name in Filename
steps: Export as FBX with scope='Selected Objects'
expected: Output file is named 'Props_Cube.fbx'

tests.title: Counter Digits
tests.notes: Audit counter digits, should start by 1, e.g. _01, _001 _0001
steps: Expand Naming, set Counter Digits to 3
Export as FBX with scope='Selected Objects'
expected: Files have zero-padded counters: e.g. 'Cube_000.fbx', 'Sphere_001.fbx', 'Cylinder_002.fbx'

tests.title: Create Subdirectories by Prefix
expected: A subdirectory 'SM/' is created inside the output dir
Both files are placed inside 'SM/'

tests.title: Create Subdirectories by Collection (No Prefix)
steps: Place objects in collection 'Props', leave Prefix empty
expected: A subdirectory 'Props/' is created
Files are placed inside 'Props/'

tests.title: Special Characters in Object Names
steps: Select it and export as FBX with default naming
expected: Illegal filename characters are stripped
File is named 'MyObjectTest.fbx' (no colons or angle brackets)

tests.title: Filter by Prefix
expected: Only 'SM_Chair.fbx' and 'SM_Table.fbx' are exported
'Light_Spot' is excluded
Report shows 2 succeeded

tests.title: Filter by Suffix
expected: Only 'Chair_LOD0.fbx' and 'Table_LOD0.fbx' are exported
'Chair_LOD1' is excluded

tests.title: Combined Prefix + Suffix Filter
expected: Only 'SM_Chair_LOD0.fbx' is exported (matches both prefix AND suffix)

tests.title: Filter Matches Nothing
steps: Create some objects with names that don't match any filter
expected: Warning: 'Nothing to export for the selected scope'
No files created, operator returns CANCELLED

tests.title: Export as FBX
tests.notes: New feature: option to export textures too, if selected, textures will be included in a folder, subfolder for material but no duplicate material exports if an object has a material that has already been exported, skip (useful when using atlases), keep the same UX guidelines used for other panels/sections
steps: Select 1 object, set format to FBX, export
expected: A valid .fbx file is created
File can be re-imported into Blender or a game engine

tests.title: Export as glTF
tests.notes: gltf takes more time to export than fbx, when exporting multiple objects, blender freezes, would be better to avoid is not responding state and show a progress
steps: Select 1 object, set format to glTF, export
expected: A valid .glb file is created
File can be opened in a glTF viewer or re-imported

tests.title: Export as OBJ
steps: Select 1 object, set format to OBJ, export
expected: A valid .obj file is created

tests.title: No Output Directory
expected: Error message: 'No output directory specified.'
No files created, Blender remains usable

tests.title: Nothing Selected (Selected Objects Scope)
tests.notes: Prompt the user if nothing is selected when using selected objects instead of nothing to export for the selected scope, this is confusing for user
steps: Open Batch Export, set scope to 'Selected Objects'
Set a valid output directory, click OK
expected: Warning: 'Nothing to export for the selected scope.'
No files created, no crash

Report shows 0 succeeded, 1+ failed with error details

tests.title: Cancel Button
expected: Dialog closes
No export happens, no files created
No errors in the console

tests.title: Successful Export Report
steps: Check the Info editor (bottom bar) for report lines
expected: Report header: 'BatchExporter — Export Report'
Shows 'Total items : 3', 'Succeeded : 3', 'Failed : 0'
EXPORTED section lists each file path with duration
Final line: 'Batch export complete: 3 succeeded, 0 failed'

tests.title: Mixed Success/Failure Report
steps: Set up a scenario where 1 export succeeds and 1 fails (e.g. one object has issues)
Run batch export and check the report
expected: Report shows correct counts for succeeded and failed
FAILURES section lists the failed item with error description
EXPORTED section lists only the successful item

tests.title: Selection Restored After Export
steps: Select Cube and Sphere in a scene with 5 objects
Run Batch Export with scope 'Selected Objects'
After export completes, check the selection state
expected: Cube and Sphere are still selected after the export
The active object is unchanged
Other objects remain unselected

tests.title: Batch Export Many Objects
tests.notes: New feature: new option that lets the user decide if he wants to export the object with the current position or at location 0,0,0 objects position in blender will remain unchanged but when importing back or to a game engine, its location will be at origin
steps: Create a scene with 50+ mesh objects
Select all, set scope to 'Selected Objects'
Export as FBX and observe timing
expected: All 50+ files created without errors
Report shows per-file duration and total duration
Blender remains responsive after export

tests.title: Repeated Exports to Same Directory
steps: Export the same objects twice to the same output directory
expected: Files are overwritten without error
Second export completes successfully
No duplicate or orphaned files
